case.summary: The evidence shows a card-not-present online purchase that is unusual for this card and customer. The amount is far above the card's prior mean, has never been seen near this level before, and the card's match flags are all true, which pushes the case toward fraud. The prior confirmed fraud case on this card/customer also involved unrecognized online activity, while the cleared cases were travel-related and do not explain this transaction.
